subject.title: feat(diffs): changed-files summary nav for multi-file patch diffs

question: Should the Diffs plugin ship this SSR changed-files navigation and static-export toolbar suppression as the intended viewer/export UX?
rationale: The code path is bounded and dependency-backed, but the PR changes user-visible viewer and exported artifact output on a protected maintainer-labeled feature.

options.title: Accept Focused Diffs UX Change
options.body: Merge this implementation after maintainer review, using the current SSR host-document nav and image-mode toolbar suppression as the approved UX.

options.title: Request Visual Export Proof First
options.body: Keep the PR open and ask for a real viewer plus PNG/PDF artifact capture before deciding whether the layout is acceptable.

options.title: Narrow Or Defer
options.body: Keep only the multi-file summary/nav or defer toolbar suppression if maintainers want separate design review.

recommendation.title: Accept Focused Diffs UX Change
recommendation.body: Merge this implementation after maintainer review, using the current SSR host-document nav and image-mode toolbar suppression as the approved UX.
